definitions.gloss: main topic, main subject, real issue
definitions.explanation: The central or primary topic of a conversation, meeting, or presentation. Often used when transitioning from preliminary remarks or small talk to the actual matter at hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧、{本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りましょう→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Well then, let's get to the main topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逸|そ}れた→逸れる：17195_soreru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}ります→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The conversation got off track, so let me return to the main point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前置|まえお}き→前置き：07704_maeoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らせて→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I've been going on with the preamble, but allow me to move on to the main subject.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the fixed phrases {本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to get to the main topic) and {本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (to get back to the main topic). A very useful expression for meetings, presentations, and formal conversations. Often marks the transition from ⟦{前置|まえお}き→前置き：07704_maeoki⟧ (preamble) or ⟦{雑談|ざつだん}→雑談：06639_zatsudan⟧ (small talk) to substantive discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get to the main topic
- {本題|ほんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the main topic
- {本題|ほんだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逸|そ}れる→逸れる：17195_soreru⟧: to stray from the main topic
